description: Six hover-lifter housings banded together on a rack, shrouds pitted from somebody else's road. The emitter faces are clean, which is the only part anybody checks. Heavy enough that loading them is a decision and light enough that a driver who thinks ahead carries a set.
name: set of lifter housings
